services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Celebrate the bounty and beauty of Oregon wine country while hosting your event at scenic Elk Cove. Sip from a range of top-scoring Pinot Noirs, crisp whites, and beautiful sparkling wines while taking in spectacular views of the northern Willamette Valley from both our indoor and outdoor spaces. Our knowledgeable hospitality team is happy to help customize your experience based on your needs. services.name: Cooking class
services.desc: Visit us at the Pearl District Culinary Farmers Market on Sunday, September 13, from 10 AM-2 PM. This summer, the Willamette Valley Wineries Association is bringing wine country to the heart of Portland through a new partnership with the Pearl District Culinary Farmers Market. Held every Sunday from June 7 through September 27, the market brings together Oregon farmers, food artisans, chefs, restaurants, and makers for a vibrant weekly gathering centered around how we cook, host, and gather. As a featured partner, the Willamette Valley Wineries Association will host a dedicated wine space showcasing rotating wineries from across the Willamette Valley.
